basic_info.description: An incredibly elegant 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom, 1-car parking flat in an ultra prime location! Vibrant purple bougainvillea flowers arch over the entryway leading into 2 Rossi Avenue. Step inside & find a bright living room framed w/beautiful windows & hardwood floors throughout. The formal dining room is spacious & can easily double as a home office. Timeless updates in the kitchen make it a perfect space for the chef of the home. Heading down the hallway you find 2 storage closest, 1 full bathroom & an oversized bedroom fitted w/custom shades on all 4 windows. Other features include; a convenient laundry room w/2 brand new washer/dryer sets, a large garage w/1 dedicated parking space for each unit & addt'l storage. This boutique 3-unit building is situated directly across from Rossi Park, a hidden gem with its newly renovated playground, kids can enjoy hours of fun on modern equipment, while sports enthusiasts can take advantage of tennis/pickle-ball courts, a basketball court + an indoor swimming pool! The park's open green spaces are perfect for picnics, jogging, or just relaxing in the sun. It's a community hub that blends recreation and relaxation, providing a serene oasis in the heart of the city. 1 block from shopping, dining, transit and a ton other conveniences on Geary!
